name: City St George's University of London
description: City University is based around several different areas in the heart of London with its main campus near the trendy Shoreditch area. City is divided into five academic Schools which include the Bayes Business School  (formerly Cass) and the City Law School, both of which are very highly regarded. City has all the benefits students expect of a London university - strong links with business for career opportunities and unbeatable opportunities for sport, culture and entertainment, and is ranked 3rd in London for student satisfaction (Complete University Guide 2020).
